review_notes: I read the whole file and compared it with the ConnectedComponent API in Connected.lean (supp, supp_injective, supp_inj and the SetLike instance, around lines 573–590). The nearest candidate is ComponentCompl.supp with its injectivity lemma and SetLike instance. These parallel ConnectedComponent.supp, but they are not the same concept. ConnectedComponent.supp on G.induce Kᶜ gives a Set ↥Kᶜ. ComponentCompl.supp gives a Set V, and the rest of the file and the ends API use it that way, for example for subset and disjointness statements about C and K. So this is a deliberately different representation, not an avoidable competitor. ComponentCompl.lift, ind and hom are specialisations built on ConnectedComponent.lift, ind and map, so they are named API, not duplicates. The ComponentCompl abbreviations are a chosen interface. componentComplFunctor and the end definition are not duplicated elsewhere in the sources I checked. I did not search the rest of Mathlib exhaustively for other ends or component-complement definitions. I saw no case for consolidation that clearly pays off.
